definitions.core: title (after removing 'Quantum AI' and 'data scien*') names AI/ML work by keyword/acronym
definitions.data_science_only: 'data scien*' with no core word (analytics; separate layer)
definitions.deepmind_only_B: A that is not CORE by other words
definitions.ai_as_domain: function unrelated to AI expertise or generic front-end/full-stack/mobile/web engineering with AI only as a label (heuristic)
definitions.year_rule: a posting counts toward every year it was captured (same as the cybersecurity analysis)

caveats: postings are only those Wayback archived, not every Google opening
yearly archived counts swing with crawl activity, so shares of observed postings are used
titles come from URL slugs: role types, not skills
supersedes: AI figures in google-wayback-job-trends.json and google-wayback-analysis.md used the broader older rule (analytics + Quantum AI included, Aiml spellings missed); superseded FOR AI ONLY. Cybersecurity numbers unaffected.
